## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] I tested with servos disconnected before changing motion or power code.
- [ ] I did not include API keys, personal data, or generated binaries.
- [ ] I checked the relevant upstream licenses.
- [ ] I updated the affected tutorial or wiring notes.
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/validate_project.py` and `git diff --check`.

AI may assist with formatting or search, but unverifiable AI-only changes will
not be merged. The author must be able to explain and reproduce this PR.
